# Version 4.153.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m153 engine update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 bumps to the Skia m153 engine, including upstream bug fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before falling back to FcFontSort on Linux. Apps relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or metrics after upgrading; specify an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 153** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to milestone 153 and merges upstream chrome/m153 bug fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## Platform

- **.NET SDK pinned to 10.0.400** — Updates the .NET SDK and container pins used to build and test SkiaSharp to 10.0.400. ([#4884](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4884))
